m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: You are looking for a Basilisk? Hmm... I wish I had better news for you, young Wizard.
Basiliks make excellent companions for Wizards, but there are those who steal and mistreat them!
There was a clutch of Basilisk eggs in the Savannah, but no more! It was taken by a poacher named Idris Beast-Taker.
Idris Beast-Taker is a rough sort, far too dangerous to approach. If I were you, I would not visit Stone Town to confront him!
That took long enough. Let me see the egg. Excellent! It looks as if it will hatch soon.
Take good care of it! There will be a quiz later.
Greetings. It has come to my attention that you are not quite up to par in the field of pet management and training.
To remedy this, I am granting you a new pet, or, more excitingly, instructing you in the way in which you can earn your own.
The pet in question is the Basilisk, a creature you should have gained passing familiarity with by now.
To learn more, I encourage you to speak to my distant colleague Kiliman Copperleaf, in the Library in Baobab Crown, in Zafaria.
As it happens, Zafaria is quite hospitable to Basilisks. Kiliman will instruct you as to where you can find one.
You should be heading to Zafaria's Baobab Crown, to speak to the Librarian, Kiliman Copperleaf. He will help get your Basilisk.
